panel.introduction: Siarnaq is a distant prograde moon of Saturn. This approximate triangular shape follows a published light-curve model’s outline, with assumed depth and polar caps. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Coarse envelope of the published convex-model views, volume-scaled to a 39 ± 6 km diameter. Projection, depth, polar caps and initial meridian are approximate; this is not the original inversion mesh.

charts.alt: JWST/NIRSpec PRISM · 2023-11-22. Archive point-source extraction, pipeline 2.0.1. Flux density with propagated 1σ errors; flagged samples are omitted from the plot and retained in the CSV. No solar-spectrum division or thermal subtraction has been applied, so this is not the published relative-reflectance spectrum. Extraction and background systematics are not included in the plotted error bars.
